title: Authorize employee master data and the salesman picker with live menu authority and bounded field validation
description: Stage 3 sales master-data closure for the employee records that supply the salesman identity used by sales orders, customers, quotations, proforma invoices, loading lists and every salesperson data-scope decision. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseDataControllers.cs:155-172 declares EmployeeController over BaseCrudController<BaseEmployee> with only [ApiController]/[Route("api/base/employees")]/[Authorize]; GetSalesmen at 166-171 returns every employee flagged IsSalesman and Status=1, and Create/Update/Delete/BatchDelete inherit the unguarded generic routes in src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseCrudController.cs:38-92 (src/ERP.Application/Services/GenericService.cs, zero Authoriz/Menu references), so any authenticated account can mint, rewrite or soft-delete a salesman identity that ERP-097 data scope and the sales document screens then resolve. Reuse the existing employee functional menu (src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:27) on every route and add bounded server-side validation for the persisted BaseEmployee columns (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/BaseEmployee.cs:9-43) before persisting, keeping the existing employee-code unique index semantics (src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/ErpDbContext.Config.cs:31) and the existing paging/response contracts unchanged. No grants, no anonymous/admin fallback, no schema change. Genuine isolated (localdb)\\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST SQL only; safe Release build plus full ERP.UnitTests.
acceptance_criteria: For every route on /api/base/employees (paged, all, by-id, create, update, delete, batch-delete and salesmen) require the current enabled nondeleted identity and the existing employee functional menu before any read or write, rejecting missing, disabled, deleted and revoked-menu identities with the existing controlled non-disclosing errors and adding no new grants or anonymous/admin fallback.

Validate on create and update that EmployeeCode and EmployeeName are non-empty and within their persisted length bounds, that Department, Position, Phone, Email and HireDate stay within their persisted shapes, and that Status is a known on/off-duty value, returning the existing controlled validation errors without silently clamping or rewriting any employee row and keeping the existing employee-code uniqueness semantics unchanged, so a rejected write persists no BaseEmployees row and the salesmen picker keeps returning only enabled salesmen.

Genuine isolated SQL authenticated controller tests cover the permitted privileged and menu-granted flows, missing employee menu, disabled, deleted and revoked identities and invalid code, name, bounds and status payloads, and assert that denied list, create, update, delete, batch-delete and salesmen calls read or mutate no BaseEmployees row while the existing GenericService contracts stay green.

Keep the safe Release build and the full existing ERP.UnitTests suite green, use only genuine isolated (localdb)\\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST databases with Integrated Security, and add no schema, entity, menu, permission or production/secret change; build completion is not stage acceptance.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseDataControllers.cs:155-172 declares EmployeeController with only [Authorize] over BaseCrudController<BaseEmployee>; GetSalesmen at 166-171 calls Service.GetAllAsync(e => e.IsSalesman && e.Status == 1) with no caller, menu or scope resolution, and Create/Update/Delete/batch-delete inherit src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseCrudController.cs:38-92 which delegates to IGenericService (src/ERP.Application/Services/GenericService.cs:31-117, zero Authoriz/Menu references). BaseEmployee (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/BaseEmployee.cs:9-43) persists EmployeeCode/EmployeeName/Department/Position/Phone/Email/HireDate/Status/IsSalesman with only attribute annotations and no server-side rule; the unique index is src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/ErpDbContext.Config.cs:31 and the existing employee menu is seeded at src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:27. The salesman identity feeds ERP-097 SalespersonDataScopeService and the sales document salesman pickers (src/ERP.Api/wwwroot/js/modules-doc.js:131,242); an exact search of .ai/tasks returned no task listing EmployeeController for live authorization.
